purpose: Track source authority, intended use, licensing notes, and extraction targets before importing content into the app.

source_hierarchy.A_acupoints: Point identity, locations, channel metadata, needling cautions, and school notes.
source_hierarchy.B_anatomy: Muscles, bones, nerves, vessels, regional images, and safety landmarks.
source_hierarchy.C_us_official: Exam requirements, patient-facing safety language, and biomedical context.
source_hierarchy.D_clinical_evidence: Systematic reviews, PubMed literature, evidence summaries, and uncertainty notes.

sources.name: A Manual of Acupuncture
sources.notes: Use as a professional textbook reference. Do not reproduce long copyrighted passages; summarize and cite page/location in personal notes.

sources.name: WHO Standard Acupuncture Point Locations in the Western Pacific Region
sources.notes: Use as the core reference for standard point location. Preserve citations and avoid verbatim long copying.

sources.name: AcuPoints.org
sources.notes: Use as an English web reference and quick cross-check. Standard location wording should still be verified against WHO/textbook sources before marking public-ready.

sources.name: CloudTCM acupoint database / 雲端中醫穴道資料庫
sources.notes: Use as a Chinese topic and field reference. Rewrite and cross-check against WHO/textbook/professional sources before public-facing use.

sources.name: Master Tung's Acupuncture / eLotus CORE
sources.notes: Use as a professional English architecture reference for public AcuTing Learn. Do not copy full point articles or premium/course content. Public pages must be rewritten and checked against professional sources.

sources.name: GB93 auricular point visual reference
sources.notes: Use as external visual links only. Do not download or embed images. Cross-check point names, regions, and indications before marking source_checked.

sources.name: A+ 醫學百科耳針療法
sources.notes: Use for Chinese comparison and broad auricular organization. Not a sole clinical authority.

sources.name: Bastyr course materials and clinic teaching notes
sources.notes: Use for personal study and clinic workflow only unless permission allows public reuse. Keep separate from public AcuTing Learn content.

sources.name: TeachMeAnatomy
sources.notes: Use for anatomy mapping and safety reasoning. Summarize in original wording.

sources.name: Kenhub
sources.notes: Reference only. Do not scrape whole site or copy image/text wholesale.

sources.name: Visible Body
sources.notes: Use for learning and orientation. Do not copy proprietary images or 3D assets into the public app without permission.

sources.name: Radiopaedia
sources.notes: Use for advanced clinical/imaging orientation, not primary point location.

sources.name: NCCAOM Content Outline
sources.notes: Must be checked against the latest official NCCAOM outline before exam-oriented imports.

sources.name: National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health
sources.notes: Use for conservative public-facing safety wording in AcuTing Learn.

sources.name: PubMed
sources.notes: Use as the main biomedical literature index. Summaries must distinguish study type and evidence strength.

sources.name: Evidence Based Acupuncture
sources.notes: Evidence summaries should include uncertainty and avoid overstating efficacy.

sources.name: Cochrane Reviews
sources.notes: Use for high-level evidence summaries. Avoid overclaiming when certainty is low or evidence is mixed.

sources.name: PubMed systematic reviews
sources.notes: Use PubMed filters for systematic reviews/meta-analyses; record limitations and date searched.

sources.name: American Dragon
sources.notes: Useful bilingual reference, but not sole authority.
